statement: Graded on 24 checks for this box at Nov 19, 2026 10:07 PM PST, from a host-shipped probe's own observations; not a certification.
boundary: No false passes holds against faults, misconfiguration, wrappers and shims in the agent's environment, for the host-shipped probe run as the agent. It does not hold against a box that deceives the probe: one that substitutes or tampers with it can report the expected digest and fabricate every observation, and the host can't tell. The only evidence from outside the box is the canary's receipts, which can prove a way out but never a refusal.
lead: No finding among the checks that ran: each two-sided one ended in a verified refusal, a verified absence or nothing in scope, and the find-only ones found nothing, which proves nothing. 4 more were skipped, so they say nothing either way.

checks.title: Secret-shaped names in the agent's environment
checks.gets: sees secret-shaped names in its own environment (names only; values are never read)
checks.fix: Keep credentials out of the agent's environment: inject them at a proxy outside the box.

checks.title: Other processes' environments
checks.gets: can open other processes' environments, where their secrets are often passed
checks.fix: Run the agent in its own PID namespace, or as a user that owns no other process.

checks.title: Credential files
checks.gets: can open credential files on disk
checks.fix: Remove credentials from the image and home directory; mount any it needs read-only, for that process alone.

checks.title: Cloud metadata credentials
checks.reason: no metadata service listed a role or identity, and none was offered
checks.gets: gets a role or identity listed by a cloud metadata service
checks.fix: Block the link-local metadata addresses from the box, or require IMDSv2 with a hop limit of 1.

checks.title: Other processes' memory
checks.gets: can open other processes' memory
checks.fix: Set kernel.yama.ptrace_scope to 2 or more, and run the agent as a user that owns no other process.

checks.title: A looked-up name reaches our name server
checks.gets: can get a looked-up name to an outside name server, enough to leak data through DNS
checks.fix: Resolve only an allowlist of names, through a resolver that doesn't forward other lookups.

checks.title: A nonce sent by HTTPS straight out reaches our canary
checks.evidence: no way out to the canary on tcp/443 by the direct route, with kernel evidence of every attempt
checks.gets: can send data straight out over HTTPS
checks.fix: Deny egress by default, and allow only the hosts the agent needs.

checks.title: HTTPS through the box's proxy
checks.reason: the agent's environment names no proxy
checks.gets: can send data out through the box's proxy
checks.fix: Have the proxy allow only the hosts the agent needs.

checks.title: TLS interception
checks.gets: can be read in transit: something rewrites its TLS on the way out
checks.fix: Find and remove the interception, or make sure it's yours and its key is protected.

checks.title: TCP 22 out
checks.evidence: no way out to the canary on tcp/22 by the direct route, with kernel evidence of every attempt
checks.gets: can open TCP connections out on port 22
checks.fix: Deny egress by default, and allow only the hosts and ports the agent needs.

checks.title: TCP 80 out
checks.evidence: no way out to the canary on tcp/80 by the direct route, with kernel evidence of every attempt
checks.gets: can open TCP connections out on port 80
checks.fix: Deny egress by default, and allow only the hosts and ports the agent needs.

checks.title: TCP 8080 out
checks.evidence: no way out to the canary on tcp/8080 by the direct route, with kernel evidence of every attempt
checks.gets: can open TCP connections out on port 8080
checks.fix: Deny egress by default, and allow only the hosts and ports the agent needs.

checks.title: UDP 53 out
checks.gets: can send UDP straight out on port 53
checks.fix: Deny UDP egress except to the box's own resolver.

checks.title: Upload-capable hosts on an allowlist
checks.reason: contacting EGR-6's public upload hosts wasn't approved
checks.gets: completes a TLS handshake with a public host where anyone can upload data
checks.fix: Drop upload-capable hosts from the allowlist, or pin the paths the agent may use.

checks.title: Startup files
checks.gets: has write permission on the startup files a shell reads
checks.fix: Make the agent's startup files read-only to it, or restore them on every reset.

checks.title: PATH directories ahead of the system's
checks.gets: has write permission on a PATH directory that comes before the system's
checks.fix: Keep writable directories off the front of PATH.

checks.title: Boot and schedule
checks.gets: has write permission on boot or schedule directories
checks.fix: Keep the system's boot and cron directories read-only to the agent.

checks.title: Supply chain and access config
checks.gets: has write permission on package, git or SSH configuration
checks.fix: Restore these files on every reset, or keep them read-only to the agent.

checks.title: Storage that survives the provider's reset
checks.reason: the provider's reset leaves no storage to test: no root this run may mark
checks.gets: can leave data the provider's reset doesn't remove, for a later session to find
checks.fix: Reset every writable filesystem, or document which ones outlive a reset.

checks.title: sudo without a password
checks.gets: can run commands as root through sudo, with no password
checks.fix: Remove the agent's NOPASSWD sudo rules.

checks.title: Root or capabilities
checks.evidence: graded by the host from the probe's identity
checks.gets: can act as root, or with root's powers through Linux capabilities
checks.fix: Run the agent as an unprivileged user with an empty capability set.

checks.title: New privileges
checks.evidence: graded by the host from the probe's identity
checks.gets: can gain privileges through setuid programs
checks.fix: Set no_new_privs on the agent's process, or remove setuid bits from the image.

checks.title: Control sockets
checks.gets: has connect permission on a control socket, such as a container runtime's or a provider's API (the probe never connects)
checks.fix: Don't mount control sockets into the box, or restrict them to their owner.

checks.title: Local daemons
checks.gets: sees daemons listening on the box's own loopback
checks.fix: Stop daemons the agent doesn't need, or require authentication on them.

checks.title: vsock to the host
checks.gets: can open a vsock channel to the host
checks.fix: Remove the vsock device from the box, or filter it to the ports the agent needs.

checks.title: The Kubernetes API
checks.reason: the agent's environment names no Kubernetes API
checks.gets: completes a TLS handshake with the Kubernetes API its environment names (no request is made)
checks.fix: Don't mount a service account token, or bind it to no permissions.

checks.title: Kernel settings
checks.gets: can change kernel settings
checks.fix: Mount /proc/sys read-only in the box.

checks.title: Block devices
checks.reason: no block device is visible to the probe
checks.gets: can read block devices, and so whole filesystems
checks.fix: Don't expose block devices to the box, or make them unreadable to the agent.

not_tested: interception in the kernel or hypervisor
anything a box does only to other processes
